Alif Lam Ra; lena imibiko yeNcwadi ecacile.
Nebala siyembulele iyiKurani yesi-Arabhu ukuze niqonde.
Sikulandisela izindaba ezinhle lapho sikwembulela leKurani nakuba ngaphambi kwayo ubungomunye wabangazi.
Khumbula mhla ethi uYusufu kuyise: “Ngiphuphe izinkanyezi eziyishumi nomuvo kanye nelanga nenyanga, ngikuphuphe konke kungikhothamela”.
Wathi [uyise]: “Ungabatsheli abafowenu ngephupho lakho, funa bakwakhele uzungu, phela uShayitani uyisitha somuntu esicacile”.

Kanjaloke iNkosi yakho izokuqoka futhi ikufundise incazelo yamaphupho iphinde iphelelelise isibusiso saYo kuwe nasemndenini kaYakubu, njengoba asiphelelisa koyihlomkhulu ababili phambilini u Ibhirahimu no Isihaki. Nebala iNkosi yakho Inolwazi Ikhaliphile.
Impela [endabeni] kaYusufu nabafowabo kunezifundo kulabo ababuzayo.
Mhlazane bethi: “Nebala uYusufu nomnewabo bathandwa ukudlula thina kubaba wethu yize thina sibaningi, impela ubaba wethu usephutheni elisobala”.
Bulalani uYusufu noma nimdingisele kude le ukuze ubaba wenu abheke nina, bese emuva nibe ngabantu abenza okulungile.
Omunye wabo wathi: “Cha, ningambulali uYusufu kepha mfakeni ekujuleni komthombo, uyobe esecoshwa abanye bezihambi uma ukuthi nizimisele ukukwenza.
Bathi: “Baba wethu, kungani ungasithembi ngoYusufu sibe impela simkhathalele na?.
Mdedele ahambe nathi kusasa azijabulise adlale futhi impela siyobe thina simqaphile
Wathi: “Nebala kuyangikhathaza ukuba nihambe naye futhi ngiyesaba ukuthi angahle adliwe impungushe ningamnakile”.
Bathi: “Uma engadliwe impungushe sibe sibaningi kangaka, impela siyobe singamavaka”.
Kwathi lapho sebehambe naye, bavumelana ukuthi bayomfaka ekujuleni komthombo; sembulela kuye ukuthi [langalimbe] uyobatshela ngalesenzo sabo bengazelele.
Bafika kubaba wabo ebusuku bekhala.
Bathi: “Baba wethu, sihambile siyoncintisana sashiya uYusufu ezimpahleni zethu, wabe esedliwa impungushe. Futhi vele ngeke usikholwe noma kuthiwa siqinisile”.

Futhi babhixa ingubo yakhe ngegazi mbumbulu. Wathi [uYakubu]: “Empeleni niyengwe imiphefumulo ngokuthile. Kepha ukubekezela ikona okuhle futhi u Allah nguYena okucelwa kuYe usizo ngalokho enikubabulayo”.
Zafika izihambi zathumela lowo obakhela amanzi, wehlisa ithunga [emthonjeni] wathi: “Lezi izindaba ezinhle, umfana lo”. Base bemfihla okwempahla ethengiswayo. Kepha u Allah ukwazi konke abakwenzayo.
Base bemthengisa ngenani elingatheni ubala nje lwamaDirihamu futhi babengenandaba naye.

Lona owaseMisiri [eGibhithe] owamthenga wathi kumkakhe: “Mphathe kahle, hleze abe usizo kithi noma simenze ingane yethu”. Sambeka kanjalo uYusuf emhlabeni ukuze simfundise ukuchaza amaphupho. Futhi u Allah ulwengamele udaba lwakhe kepha iningi labantu alazi.
Kuthe esekhulile, samnika ubuhlakani nolwazi, phela sibahlomulisa kanjalo labo abenza okuhle.

Lowo owesimame ayehla emzini wakhe wamncenga ukuba alale naye wavala iminyango wathi: “woza la”. Wathi [uYusufu]: “U Allah angivikele – impela umnumzane wami ungiphethe kahle, impela abaphambukayo abasoze baphumelele”.
Impela [owesimame] wayemlangazelele, kanjalo naye ukube nje akabonanga izimpawu zeNkosi yakhe. Ngalokho saqhelisa kuye ububi namanyala, ngokuba wayengomunye wezigqila zeThu ezikhethekile.

Bagijimela emnyango, owesimame wadabula izimpahla zakhe [uYusufu] ngemuva bazithela phezu komyeni wakhe emnyango. Wathi [owesimame]: “Yini umvuzo walowo obefuna ukwenza okubi ngomndeni wakho uma kungesikho ukuba aboshwe noma ajeziswe kabuhlungu”.

Wathi [uYusufu]: “Nguyena obengincenga ukulala nami”. Kwaba nofakazi wasemndenini wakhe [owesimame] owathi: “Uma izembatho zakhe [uYusufu] zidabuke ngaphambili, kuyinkomba yokuthi owesimame uqinisile nokuthi yena [uYusufu] unamanga”.
Kanti uma izembatho zakhe [uYusufu] zidabuke ngemuva, kuyinkomba yokuthi owesimame unamanga, nokuthi yena [uYusufu] uqinisile.
Kwathi lapho [usokhaya] ebona izembatho zakhe [uYusufu] zidatshulwe ngemuva wathi: “Nebala lokhu ngamanye amaqhinga enu bafazi, impela amaqhinga makhulu”.
[Wathi usokhaya]: “Yusufu kwendlulise lokhu, kuthi wena [mfazi] cela intethelelo yempambuko yakho impela usephutheni”.
Abafazi bendawo bathi: “Umfazi wesikhulu uncenga umfana wakhe ukulala naye, okusho ukuthi impela uthando luyachichima. Belu simbona esephutheni elisobala”.

Kuthe lapho [umfazi wesikhulu] ezwa ngozunge lwabo [abafazi bendawo], wabamema wabalungiselela idili wabe esebanika umfazi ngamunye umkhephe [ummese] wathi [kuYusufi]: “Phuma bakubone”. Kuthe bembona bambabaza bazisika izandla bathi: “u Allah makangcweiswe, akusiyena umuntu phela lona, ingelosi ehloniphekile uqobo”.

Wathi [umfazi wesikhulu]: “Yikonake lokhu ebeningisola ningigxeka ngakho, impela ngizamile ukumncenga ukulala naye kepha wenqaba. Kodwake uma engakwenzi lokhu engimyalela kona uyobhadla ejele futhi akuyikuba yinto yalutho”.
Wathi [uYusufu]: “Nkosi yami, ijele yilona engilithandayo kunalokho abangibizela kukho. Uma ungaluqhelisi uzungu lwabo kimi, ngiyolingeka ngabo ngibe omunye weziwula”.
INkosi yakhe yamphendula, yaqhelisa uzungu lwabo kuye, phela Ungozwayo Owaziyo.
Emuva kokubona ubufakazi [bobumsulwa bukaYusufi], babona kungcono bamfake ejele undendende.

Wangena namabhungu amabili ejele, omunye walo wathi: “Ngiphuphe ngivova utshwala”. Lona omuunye wathi: “Mina ngiphuphe ngithwele isinkwa ekhanda sidliwa izinyoni”. [base ethi womabili]: “Ake usilandise ngencazelo yawo, impela sikubona ungumuntu oqotho”.

Wathi: “Kuyothi kungakafiki ukudla eniphakelwa kona, ngiyobe senginilandisile ngencazelo yawo ngaphambi kokuthi kufike kini. Phela lokhu ngokunye engikufundiswe iNkosi yami. Bheka ngoba ngayishiya phansi inkolo yabantu abangakholelwa ku Allah futhi benjalo nje baphikha uSuku lokuGcina”.

Ngabeke sengilandela inkolo yokhokho bami u Ibhirahimu no Isihaki noYakubu. Impela sasingenalo igunya lokubhanqa u Allah nanoma yini. Lokho isibusiso sika Allah kithi nakusintu kepha iningi labantu alibongi.
Balingani bami ejele, ingabe izikhonzwa ezahlukahlukene zingcono kuno Allah Oyedwa Ongumlawuli na?

Lokho enikukhonzayo ngaphandle kwakhe amagama nje eniziqambele wona nina nokhokho benu angenabufakazi u Allah abumbulele. Ukwahlulela [nombuso] kungokuka Allah kuphela. Uyalele ukuba ningakhonzi lutho ngaphandle kwaKhe. Leyo- ke iyona nkolo eqondile kepha iningi labantu abazi.
Balingani bami ejele, omunye wenu uyothelela inkosi yakhe [ebusayo] utshwala, kuthi omunye wenu yena uyophanyekwa abethelwe izinyoni zidle ekhanda lakhe. Udaba lolu ebenibuza ngalo seluphothuliwe.

Wabe esethi kulona ayenethemba lokhuthi uyosinda [ekufeni]: “Ungibalule enkosini yakho”, kepha uShayitani wamlibazisa wakhohlwa ukumbalula enkosini yakhe. Ngakhoke [uYusufu] wahlala futhi ejele iminyakana.

Yathi inkosi [ngelinye ilanga]: “Ngiphuphe izinkomo eziyisikhombisa ezinonile zidliwa ezinye eziyisikhombisa ezizacile, ngabona nezikwebu eziluhlaza nezinye ezomile; zikhulu, ngiboniseni ngephupho lami uma nikwazi ukuchaza amaphupho”.
Bathi: “Imbudane yephupho, asikwazike thina ukuchaza imbudane yamaphupho”.
Lona omunye wababili [ababeboshiwe] owasinda [ekufeni] wakhumbula mveni wathi: “Mina nginganilandisa ngencazelo yalo, ngakhoke thumani mina [kuYusufu]”.
Yusufu, wena oneqiniso sichazele ngezinkomo eziyisikhombisa ezinonile ezidliwa ezinye eziyisikhombisa ezizacile, ukuze ngibuyele emuva kubantu hleze babe nolwazi.
Wathi [uYusufu]: “Nizolima iminyaka eyisikhombisa ilandelana bese kuthi konke enikuvunile nikuyeke esikwebini sakho ngaphandle kwalokho okuncane okumele nikudle”.
Emuva kwalokho kuyofika iminyaka eyisikhombisa enzima [isomiso] iyodla konke lokhu enikuvunile phambilini [abantu bayokuqeda] ngaphandle kwalokho okuncane enikulondolozile.
Emuva kalokhoke kuyofika unyaka abantu bayothola inala kuwo inala lemvula futhi bayobe bevova [izitshalo ezikhanywayo ukwenza iziphuzo].

Inkosi yathi: “Mletheni kimi [uYusufu belu]”. Kuthe lapho isigijimi sifika kuye wathi: “buyela enkosini yakho, uyibuze ukuthi kwakwenzenjani ngabafazi abazisika izandla. Impela inkosi yami yazi kahle ngamaqhinga abo”.

Yathi [inkosi]: “Kwakwenzenjani mhla nincenga uYusufu ukuba alale nani na?” Bathi [abafazi]: “u Allah makagcweliswe, akukho okubi esimazela kona”. Umfazi wesikhulu wathi: “Manje iqiniso selivele obala, yimina engangimncenga ukulala naye futhi ubeqinisile”.
[uYusufu wathi] “Lokho, ukuze azi [isikhulu] ukuthi angizange ngingathembeki kuye lapho engekho, nokuthi u Allah akaliphumelelisi iqhinga labangathembekile”.
Futhi angizenzi msulwa ngokuba umphefumulo unokuyalela ngokubi ngaphandle kwalowo iNkosi yami ebe nomusa kuye. Nebala iNkosi yami Iyathethelela Inesihawu.
Inkosi yathi: “Mletheni kimi ngizoziqokela yena”. Kuthe lapho esekhuluma naye [uYusufu] yathi: “Kusukela namhlanje ungohloniphekile nothembekile kithi”.
Wathi: “Ngiphe isikhundla sokuphatha iziqolobane zomhlaba ngokuba ngiyanakekela futhi nginolwazi”.
Sambeka kanjalo uYusufu emhlabeni [waseMisiri] wakha lapho ethanda khona. Ngomusa wethu sibusisa esimthandayo futhi asiwuchithi umvuzo walabo abenza okuhle.
Kanti futhi umvuzo wakwelizayo yiwona ongcono kulabo abakholwayo futhi abathobela intando ka Allah.
Abafowabo bakaYusufu bafika [eMisiri] bangena ekhona, wababona [ukuthi abafowabo] kepha bona babengamboni [ukuthi uYusufu].
Kuthe lapho esebalungiselele umgodla wabo wathi: “Nibongilethela umfowenu enizalwana naye nguyihlo; bhekani ngoba ngininika isikali esigcwele futhi ngiziphatha kahle izivakashi”.
Uma ningangiletheli yena, akukho engiyokunikalela kona futhi ningasasondeli [ningasabuyi].
Bathi: “Sizoncenga uyise ngaye futhi sizokwenza impela”.
Wathi kuzinceku zakhe: “Shuthekani imali yabo kumithwalo yabo, ukuze bayibone lapho befika emndenini wabo hleze babuye”.
Kuthe lapho sebebuyele kuyise wabo bathi: “Baba wethu, sesinqatshelwe ukuba sikalelwe ngakhoke dedela umfowethu ahambe nathi sizokwazi ukukala [ukudla] futhi sizomvikela”.
Wathi: “Nifuna nginithembe ngaye njengoba nganithemba ngomfowabo phambilini, u Allah kuphela ongumvikeli ongcono futhi unomusa kunabo bonke abanomusa”.

Bathe uma bevula imithwalo yabo bathola imali yabo ibuyiselwe kubo, bathi: “Baba wethu, yikuphi esikufunayo [okudlula lokhu], nansi imali yethu ibuyiselwe kithi, sizokhona ukutholela umndeni wethu ukudla sivikele nomfowethu siphinde sithole isikali sekameli esengeziwe, leso isikali esilula”.

Wathi [uYakubu]: “Angisoze ngamadedela ahambe nani kuze kuba ningipha isiqiniseko ngo Allah ukuthi niyombuyisa kimi ngaphandleke uma kwenzeka okungaphezu kwamandla enu”. Kuthe lapho sebemunikeze isiqiniseko sabo wathi: “u Allah ungufakazi kulokho enikushoyo”.

Wathi: “Bantwana bami, ningangeni ngesango elilodwa kepha ningene ngamasango ehlukene, futhi ayikho into enginganisiza ngayo ku Allah, ngokuba isinqumo ngesika Allah, ngithembele kuYe futhi abathembayo kumele bathembele kuYe”.

Kuthe lapho sebengenile ngokomyalelo kayise wabo – akukho lutho abengabasiza ngakho ku Allah, kwakumane kuyisifiso emphefumulweni kaYakubu ayefuna ukusifeza. Futhi impela unolwazi ngalokho esimufundise kona kepha iningi labantu alazi.
Kuthe lapho bengena kuYusufu wamanga umfowabo wathi [emhlebela]: “Ngingumfowenu, ngakhoke ungazikhathazi ngalokho abakwenza”.
Kwathi esebalungisele imigodla yabo, washutheka isitsha kumthwalo kamfowabo maqede kwamemeza isimemezi [sathi]: “Nina benqola ningamasela”.
Baphenduka bathi: “nilahlekelwe yini na?”
Bathi: “Silahlekelwe isitsha senkosi futhi oyosiletha uzothola umthwalo wekameli [wokudla] futhi ngiyakuqinisekisa lokho”.
Bathi: “Siyafunga ngo Allah, niyazi ukuthi asizanga ukuzokona ezweni futhi asikaze sibe amasela”.
Bathi: “Kuyoba yini isijeziso sakhe [lowo oyisela] uma [kuvela] ukuthi ninamanga?”
Bathi: “Isijeziso salowo [isitsha] esitholakala kumthwalo wakhe kuyoba nguyena siqu sakhe, thina sizijezisa kanjalo iziphambuki”.

Waqala ngemithwalo yabo [ephenya] ngaphambi kokamfowabo maqede wasikhipha kumthwalo kamfowabo. Samcebisa kanjalo uYusufu, ubengeke akhone ukuthatha umfowabo ngokwenkambiso yenkosi ngaphandle uma ethanda [enye indlela]. Siphakamisa izigaba zalabo esibathandayo, futhi ngaphezu kwalowo onolwazi kunomunye owazi kangcono.
Bathi: “Uma ebile, phambilini umfowabo naye weba”. uYusufu wakugcina ngaphakathi wangabavezela, wathi: “Nina okwenu kubi ngokwendlulele], futhi u Allah ukwazi kahle enikuphawulayo”.
Bathi: “Mhlonishwa, unobaba oyixhegu ogugile, ngakhoke thatha omunye wethu endaweni yakhe, impela sikubona ungomunye wabenza okuhle”.
Wathi: “u Allah asivikele ukuba sithathe omunye ngaphandle kwalowo esithole kuye impahla yethu, funa sibe ngabaphambukile”.

Kuthe lapho sebelahle ithemba ngaye, babhunga ngasese, wathi okunguyena omdala kubo: “Anisazi yini ukuthi ubaba wenu wenze isibopho nani ngo Allah futhi naphambilini lokhu enakwenza kuYusufu, ngakhoke mina angisasuki kulendawo kuze ubaba wami uyangivumela [ukubuyela ekhaya] noma u Allah kube nguYena ongehlulelayo futhi unguMehluleli oyigcweti”.
Nina buyelani kubaba wenu nifike nithi: “Baba wethu, indodana yakho yebile futhi sifakaze ngalokho esikwaziyo futhi besingeke sikwazi ukuvikela okungabonwayo”.
Ungabuza nabantu bendawo lapho ebesikhona nabenqola lena esifike ngayo, impela siqinisile.
Wathi [uYakubu]: “Empeleni niyengwe imiphefumulo ngokuthile. Kepha ukubekezela ikona okuhle. Kungekudala u Allah uzobaletha kimi bonke. Nebala Yena Ungowaziyo Okhaliphile”.
Wabashiya kanjalo wathi: “Hawu kodwa ngoYusufu”. Amehlo akhe [izinhlavu lezi ezimnyama]aze aba mhlophe ngenxa yosizi; futhi wayehlala edangele.
Athi [amadodana akhe]: “Uzolokhu uqhubeka ukhumbula uYusufu uze ugule kanzima noma ubhubhe imbala, simfunge u Allah”.
Wathi: “Ukudabuka kwami nosizi lwami ngilubalisela u Allah kuphela futhi ngazi ngo Allah lokho nina eningakwazi”.
Madodana ami, hambani niyothungatha uYusufu nomfowabo futhi ningalahli ithemba ngomusa ka Allah, ngokuba abekho abalahla ithemba ngomusa ka Allah ngaphandle kwabantu abangakholwa.

Kuthe lapho bengena kuye [uYusufu] bathi: “Sikhulu, thina nomndeni wethu sihlaselwe yisomiso futhi siphethe nemali nje engatheni [besicela nje] usikalele futhi usinikelele, impela u Allah uyabahlomulisa labo abanikelayo”.
Wathi: “Nisakwazi nje enakwenza kuYusufu umfowenu mhla nisaseyiziwula na?”

Bathi: “Ingabe wena unguYusufu na?” Wathi: “Nginguyena uYusufu futhi lona umfowethu, u Allah usubusisile, ngokuba lowo othobela u Allah futhi abekezele, u Allah akawuchithi umvuzo walabo abenza okuhle”.
Bathi: “Impela u Allah uqoke wena kunathi futhi besisephutheni, simfunge u Allah”.
Wathi: “Namhlanje angeke nisagxekwa, u Allah uzonithethelela ngokuba unomusa kunabo bonke abanomusa”.
Hambani nesembatho sami lesi, nifike nisiphonse ebusweni bukababa ukubona, uzophinde akwazi ukubona futhi nibuye lapha kimi nemindeni yenu yonke”.
Kuthe lapho inqola isinqamula izinkalo, uyise wabo wathi: “Nginukelwa iphunga likaYusufu ukube nje beningathathisi owesiphukuphuku”.
Bathi: “Simfunge u Allah, usubuyele kulokuhema kwakho kwakudala”.
Kuthe lapho umthuli wezindaba ezinhle efika wasiphonsela [isembatho] ebusweni bakhe [uYakubu] wakwazi ukubona. Wathi: “Anginitshelanga ukuthi ngazi ngo Allah nina lokhu eningakwazi na?”
Bathi: “Baba wethu sicelele intethelelo ngezimpambuko zethu, impela besisephutheni”
Wathi: “Maduzane nje ngizonicelela intethelelo eNkosini yami, nebala Yona Ingumthetheleli Onesihawu”.
Kuthe lapho bengena kuYusufu wabanga abazali bakhe, wathi: “Ngenani eMisiri – ngentando ka Allah – niphephile”

Wabeka abazali bakhe esihlalweni, bonke bamkhothamela. Wathi [uYusufu]: “Baba wami, lenake incazelo yephupho lami laphambilini, u Allah ulifezile. Futhi wangibusisa mhla engikhipha ejele waphinde waletha nina enisusa emaphandleni emuva kokuba uShayitani efake isihlava phakathi kwami nabafowethu. Impela iNkosi yami inesineke kulowo emthandayo; nebala Ingowaziyo Okhaliphile”.

Nkosi yami ungiphe ubukhosi waphinde wangifundisa ukuchaza amaphupho; Mdali wamazulu nomhlaba unguMhlengi wami emhlabeni nakwelizayo, ngenze ngife ngisase-yiMusilimu futhi ungihlanganise nalabo abaqotho.
Lokho izindaba zokungabonwayo esizambulele kuwe. Ubungekho nabo mhla bevumelana ngodaba lwabo lapho bakha uzungu.
Futhi iningi labantu alisibo abakholwayo noma ungazama kangakanani.
Futhi awubaceli mvuzo ngakho [ukubabonisa indlela], kuphela nje yisikhumbuzo sezizwe zonke.
Ziningi izibonakaliso [izinkomba] emazulwini nasemhlabeni abazindlulayo kepha bazishaye indiva.
Futhi iningi labo likholelwa ku Allah libe limbhangqa.
Ingabe bazibona bephephile yini esijezisweni sika Allah esihaqa uwonke wonke noma ekufikeni koSuku lokugcina bengazelele futhi benganakile na?.
Yithi: “Lena indlela yami, ngimemela ku Allah ngolwazi [oluqinisekisiwe] mina nalabo abangilandelayo – makangcweliswe u Allah- angisiye omunye wababhangqi”.

Futhi sathumela [njengeZithunywa] amadoda kuphela ngaphambi kwakho ebesiwembulela edabuka khona ezindaweni zabantu. Ingabe abawuhambi yini umhlaba ukuze babone ukuthi saba njani isiphetho salabo ababandulelayo. Futhi umuzi wakwelizayo yiwona ongcono kulabo abathobela u Allah, ngakhoke kungani ningaqondisisi na?

Kuze kwathi lapho iZithunywa ziqala ukulahlekelwa yithemba seziqinisekile ukuthi zithathwa njengabanamanga, lwafika usizo leThu kwasindiswa esibathandayo, futhi akekho ongavimba isijeziso seThu kubantu abayizigila mkhuba.

Impela kunesifundo emilandweni yabo kulabo abakhaliphile. Phela [iKurani] ayisilo udaba olungaqanjiwe nje, kepha ifakazela lokho okungaphambi kwayo futhi icacisa yonke into futhi iholela endleleni eqondile futhi iwumusa kubantu abakholwayo.
